title: PA Compact
intro: PAs licensed in one PA Compact state can apply here for a Compact Privilege to practice in others.

pa.title: PAs
pa.text: Join the PA Compact, then apply for Compact Privileges in other states.

staff.title: State and Commission staff
staff.text: Review applications and manage PA records for your state.

lookup.title: Look up a Compact Privilege
lookup.text: Check whether a PA holds a Compact Privilege in a state. You don't need an account.
